Kaiyaṭa
son of Candrāditya; grandson of Vallabhadeva an. protege of Bhīmagupta of Kashmir (977-82 A. D.).
--C. on Ānandavardhana's Devīśataka composed in 977 A. D.
Pt.. K. M. Gucch. IX. p.. 1-31.

Kaiyaṭa
son of Jaiyaṭa an. pupil of Maheśvara. Ref. to Bhartṛhari's C. on Mahābhāṣya an. to

th Cent. A. D. On 1150 A. D. a. his date, see V. Raghavan, JOR. Madras, XIX. iii. p.. 223-4. See also ABORI. XII. ii. p.. 246-51.
